entities.name: Agrus Kos
entities.description: A former Boros Legion hero working as a bouncer in Utvara who searches for his missing friend Feather and dies in the novel.

entities.name: Teysa Karlov
entities.description: An Orzhov cousin of Uncle made baroness of Utvara; she leads the people against Hauc's plan.

entities.name: Uncle
entities.description: An Orzhov patriarch who made Teysa baroness and had Hauc drop the mana bomb; he is killed and becomes a ghost of the Obzedat.

entities.name: Melisk
entities.description: Uncle's right hand, who abused Teysa and erased her memory; he is murdered by the Taj.

entities.name: Zomaj Hauc
entities.description: An Izzet magelord working in the Cauldron who tries to hatch dragon eggs to destroy the Guildpact; he dies in a dogfight.

entities.name: Crix
entities.description: A goblin with a message for Hauc and a spell engraved on her metal arm.

entities.name: Kaluzax
entities.description: An Izzet goblin who piloted an observosphere to drop a mana bomb over Utvara and crashed.

entities.name: Aun Yom
entities.description: A Gruul bandit killed by something invisible whose body rises again, possessed by Taj.

entities.name: Vor Golozar
entities.description: A less bloodthirsty Gruul who captures Crix.

entities.name: Trijiro
entities.description: An old Gruul centaur and leader of Golozar's tribe.

entities.name: Pivlic
entities.description: Owner of a new bar in Utvara who joins the rescue of Crix.

entities.name: Aradoz
entities.description: A half-demon hired by Teysa to build a mansion.

entities.name: Dr. Nebun
entities.description: A Simic vedalken who had a cure for the Kuga plague.

entities.name: Niv-Mizzet
entities.description: Izzet dragon guildmaster whom Hauc plans to overthrow.

entities.name: Feather
entities.description: Kos's long-lost friend who emerges from the kuga mot.

entities.name: Vitar Yescu
entities.description: A Selesnyan tree that keeps the plague away within Utvara.

entities.name: Taj
entities.description: Ghost-assassins who possessed Aun Yom and his tribe; Teysa takes control of them.

entities.name: Obzedat
entities.description: The Orzhov ghost council, which made a deal with Niv-Mizzet and financed Hauc.

entities.name: Grugg Brothers
entities.description: Teysa's thrull aides.

entities.name: Utvara
entities.description: A valley township on Ravnica struck by the Kuga plague.

entities.name: Cauldron
entities.description: An Izzet laboratory in Utvara where Hauc works.

entities.name: Schism
entities.description: A wrinkle in the sky created by the mana bomb explosion that absorbs ghosts.

entities.name: Kuga plague
entities.description: A plague in Utvara that mutates after the explosion.

entities.name: Kuga mot
entities.description: A glowing sphere or apparition that hangs over the Schism.

entities.name: Parhelion
entities.description: A ship still missing since the end of the first novel.

entities.name: Izzet League
entities.description: The guild of Kaluzax, Hauc and Crix's contacts.

entities.name: Gruul Clans
entities.description: The guild whose bandits and tribes appear in Utvara.

entities.name: Orzhov Syndicate
entities.description: The guild of Uncle and Teysa.

events.summary: Izzet goblin Kaluzax is shot down by Gruul while flying an observosphere to bomb Utvara.
events.quote: Kaluzax is attacked by Gruul however and goes down with the ship.

events.summary: Uncle makes Teysa baroness of Utvara and they travel there by lokopede with Melisk and Crix.
events.quote: makes his cousin Teysa Karlov the baroness of Utvara

events.summary: Uncle reveals he had Hauc drop the mana bomb; it goes awry, creating the Schism and mutating the plague.
events.quote: the explosion creates a weird wrinkle in the sky called the Schism and causes the plague to mutate.

events.summary: Aun Yom is killed and rises again; his band attacks the lokopede and Uncle is killed.
events.quote: Aun Yom and his band of thugs, or whoever is in their bodies now, attack the lokopede.

events.summary: Teysa and Melisk bring Uncle's corpse into Pivlic's bar where Kos works.
events.quote: carrying the corpse of Uncle, who was killed during the Gruul attack.

events.summary: Teysa hires Aradoz and charges Dr. Nebun with curing the Kuga plague.
events.quote: She charges him with making a cure for the Kuga plague

events.summary: Uncle becomes a ghost, joins the Obzedat and watches Teysa through a mirror.
events.quote: He now is a ghost and has joined the Obzedat

events.summary: Kos studies the Schism and sees the Kuga mot while searching for Feather and Parhelion.
events.quote: The Kuga Mot appears, a mysterious glowing sphere or apparition

events.summary: Trijiro orders Crix released to improve Gruul relations with other guilds.
Teysa sends Pivlic, Kos and the Grugg Brothers to rescue Crix; Nebun reveals he always had a cure and Teysa buys it.
events.quote: Nebun reveals that he had a cure for the Kuga all along.

events.summary: Crix and Kos's parties flee Aun Yom's party and realize they are zombies.
events.quote: figure out that they are actually zombies along the way.

events.summary: Teysa discovers Melisk has been erasing her memory and that Uncle's death and the deal with Niv-Mizzet were Obzedat schemes; she breaks her oath.
Kos and the others find Hauc trying to hatch three dragon eggs to destroy the Guildpact; he orders them killed.
events.quote: Hauc is trying to get three dragon eggs to hatch.

events.summary: Teysa rallies Utvara against the Cauldron and takes control of the Taj, who murder Melisk.
events.quote: They murder Melisk and join Teysa's army.

events.summary: Teysa breaks into the Cauldron and has Pivlic administer cures so the dragons cannot breathe.
events.quote: the dragons can't breathe normal air, only Kuga-infected air.

events.summary: A dragon awakens and Hauc commands it; Teysa reads Crix's spell to command the last dragon.
events.quote: making the final dragon hers to command.

events.summary: In a dogfight Hauc dies; the two dragons kill each other.
events.quote: The two dragons kill each other

events.summary: Kos is impaled in the crash, sees Feather emerge from the kuga mot, and dies.
At Kos's funeral Hauc's spirit awakens, hearing voices of other spirits.
events.quote: Hauc's spirit awakens and hears the voices of other spirits calling him.

relations.quote: makes his cousin Teysa Karlov the baroness of Utvara
Agrus Kos is now working for him as a bouncer.
They murder Melisk and join Teysa's army.
Trijiro is the leader of Golozar's Gruul tribe
Hauc works in the Cauldron , an Izzet laboratory in Utvara
